content.text: Give her a light snack about 30 to 60 minutes before swim, like a banana, toast or yogurt. A full meal right before can make her uncomfortable in the water, and swimming on empty tends to end in a hungry, cranky kid. With a 10am start, an early breakfast and a small top-up on the way works well. Then bring a snack for right after, since she'll probably be starving.
